meta.aciklama:
Claude Obsidian is a free Claude Code plugin that turns what you read into a linked second brain in Obsidian.

It's based on Andrej Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.

Drop a paper, an article, a transcript or your own notes into inbox/. Claude writes linked notes with sources, indexes and maps of content, and files them into one knowledge graph you can browse in Obsidian's Graph view.

Ask a question and it answers from what your vault already knows, with citations. A health check finds dead links, orphan pages and gaps. Everything stays as plain Markdown files on your computer, with no cloud database. No lock-in, no telemetry.

The catch: you need Claude Code and Python 3.11 or newer, and Windows users should run it in WSL.

Repo: https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian

Save this if your notes are a mess.

#obsidian #claudecode #secondbrain
